items.title: The Black Skirts — EVERYTHING
items.description: “EVERYTHING” is a love song from TEAM BABY. It first came out as a single in 2016, a year before the album.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: The Black Skirts — EVERYTHING. Typographic card.

items.title: sunwoojunga — Run with Me
items.description: Here’s “Run with Me” at sunwoojunga’s SERENADE concert, shared on her own channel. The song comes from her 2019 album Serenade; this performance was recorded at Sogang University’s Mary Hall.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: sunwoojunga — Run with Me. Typographic card.

items.title: Car, the garden — Tree
items.description: Here’s Car, the garden singing “Tree” for Begin Again’s Open Mic series. The song first came out as a single in April 2019.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Car, the garden — Tree. Typographic card.

items.title: Choi Yu Ree — Forest
items.description: “Forest” is about feeling small among other people, and finding a place with them. Choi Yu Ree wrote it for her 2022 single release Stroll. This version is from a Bugs-ker live session.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Choi Yu Ree — Forest. Typographic card.

items.title: BOL4 — Eternal love
items.description: Ahn Ji-young sings “Eternal love” (사랑할 수밖에) at BOL4’s 2024 Bloom concert in this clip from her own channel. The song is from the 2023 EP Merry Go Round.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: BOL4 — Eternal love. Typographic card.

items.title: ESEGYE — RomanceYouthLove
items.description: “RomanceYouthLove” was one of ESEGYE’s first releases. This recording is from their first BLIND concert at Veloso Hongdae, shared by the band themselves.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: ESEGYE — RomanceYouthLove. Typographic card.

items.title: SE SO NEON — The Wave
items.description: “The Wave” keeps going after the last vocal line, with an extended instrumental ending. This version comes from the 2020/NEON concert, filmed at YES24 Live Hall on December 7, 2019.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: SE SO NEON — The Wave. Typographic card.

items.title: YdBB — ONCE
items.description: “ONCE” is about letting someone go while hoping they’ll remember you kindly. Yu Dabin describes that farewell in the band’s release interview for the October 2023 single.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: YdBB — ONCE. Typographic card.

items.title: WhiteUsedSocks — Don’t feel sad
items.description: “Don’t feel sad” comes from WhiteUsedSocks’ early days. Jung Jaeheon wrote and composed the song, released in June 2017, before The Little Match Boy and Through Yearning.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: WhiteUsedSocks — Don’t feel sad. Typographic card.

items.title: Motte — Don’t run away
items.description: “Don’t run away” was part of the September 2018 soundtrack to A-TEEN. It’s an easy place to meet Motte’s music, even if you’ve never seen the series.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Motte — Don’t run away. Typographic card.

items.title: HANRORO — Even if you leave
items.description: “Even if you leave” is about the things that are hard to let go of, and the habit of blaming yourself after they’re gone. HANRORO wrote both the words and music.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: HANRORO — Even if you leave. Typographic card.

items.title: Kim Sawol — Someone
items.description: “Someone” holds affection and doubt together. It’s from Kim Sawol’s second album, Romance, released in September 2018.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Kim Sawol — Someone. Typographic card.

items.title: Yerin Baek — 0310
items.description: “0310” is sung in English, with the words on screen in Baek’s own lyric video. It’s from her 2019 album Every letter I sent you.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Yerin Baek — 0310. Typographic card.

items.title: Yoon Mirae — Breath
items.description: In “Breath”, guitar leaves plenty of space around Yoon Mirae’s voice. The song is about the ordinary things that remind you of someone after a breakup.
items.altText: indiek listening notes: Yoon Mirae — Breath. Typographic card.
